Hi team — quick technical confirmation: Redwood's PO ingestion accepts alphanumeric PO identifiers up to 16 chars. The system matcher looks for exact PO string unless you opt into our PO normalization mapping. The SC+8 format shouldn't break anything, but if Suncrest wants guaranteed auto-apply to invoices, we recommend the mapping table that maps your SC-prefixed POs to our internal PO field (two small config entries on our side).

Options:
- Opt A (recommended): We add a normalization rule for Suncrest that strips the leading "SC" when matching — zero changes to your EDI output.
- Opt B: Suncrest changes outgoing POs to match the existing numeric format (more work on your side).

If you confirm Opt A, I can push the mapping to staging and validate with a sample PO.

Karthik
Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
